title: Moving card templates: a sliding bus and a lifting Tower Bridge
subject: Art & Design
unit: Summer 1: City drawing and moving cards (Bright Lights, Big City)
source: Written for art/y1 lesson 9 (Moving card templates: bus and Tower Bridge (portal printable; no people))
intro: Lesson 9: A London card that moves. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

labels: Draw and colour a red bus, then cut it out
Glue the bus onto this strip

box.title: The street: an adult cuts a slot along the dotted road line

blocks.text: Join each half of the road to a tower with a split pin (the pivot). Push the ends down and the road lifts up in the middle, like the real bridge.

panels.title: Sliders
points: Cut a slot in the card
Pull the strip to move the picture

panels.title: Levers
points: A split pin is the pivot
Push the end and it turns

parts.text: Adult cuts a slot along the road
Glue the bus to a strip
Push the strip through the slot

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: A bus that slides along the street

keywords.def: parts that work together to make something move
a strip that moves along a slot
a bar that turns around a point
the point a lever turns on
say what is good and what to improve

questions.q: Which moves along a slot: a slider or a lever?
What can we use as a pivot?
Which part of Tower Bridge lifts up?
Core: Make a London card with a slider (a bus moving along a street) or a lever (Tower Bridge lifting).
questions.a: A card with one working mechanism

questions.q: Extend: Add a second moving part.
questions.a: A second slider or lever that works

questions.q: Stretch: Say one thing that went well and one thing to improve.
questions.a: For example: the bus slides well; the slot was too tight
A) Pivot. The split pin is the pivot; a slider moves in a slot.
